checks.name: Empty controls and complete v8.2 project-scoped offline cache
Mixed image and two-page PDF import with real detection and OCR
Four clockwise turns preserve image pixels, selected results, edits, verification and export order
PDF native /Rotate plus manual counterclockwise correction, fresh detection and OCR
PDF high-resolution crops and retries work at all four angles; page 2 remains independent
Manual selection, candidate click and TXT/CSV downloads after rotation
Rotation waits safely for navigation away and back; paused scans still rescan explicit turns
Rotation failure leaves image geometry and completed output intact, then can retry
390px controls fit the page and remain usable
Removal and clearing during a pending rotation do not restore deleted pages
Sideways photo can be corrected and freshly recognized before selecting any text
Downsized image retains full-resolution OCR crops after rotation and navigation
JPEG EXIF orientation is composed with manual turns and full-resolution crops
All eight JPEG EXIF orientations keep preview, crop and rotated retry aligned
Offline reload supports new image/PDF rotation and actual OCR without the server
No uncaught errors, external requests or write requests

fixtures: Synthetic PNG, JPEG with EXIF orientations 1-8, large PNG and a two-page PDF with native /Rotate 90; no user files.
limits: Automated desktop Chrome and 390px viewport; no physical phone or Safari test.
Synthetic serials validate behavior, not accuracy across all card photos.
